title: COVID-19 Patient Sample Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Set up robot deck
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons 1000 µL filter tip rack, a KingFisher 2 mL deep‑well plate (96‑well format), and the patient tube rack in the deck according to the provided deck map, with patient tubes in deck slot 4.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tip rack, deep‑well plate, and the P1000 Multichannel GEN2 pipette as described in the calibration guide.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol .py file from the source repository and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and select any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the downloaded .py protocol file.

steps.title: Single extraction aliquoting
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL (default) of patient sample from each tube in deck slot 4 to the corresponding well of the KingFisher deep‑well plate, moving down the column for both tube racks and the plate. Example: tube A1 → well A1, tube B1 → well B1, then continue down the column. Do not aliquot into wells G12 and H12.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL from patient tube slot 4 position A1 into well A1 of the deep‑well plate.
Transfer 200 µL from patient tube slot 4 position B1 into well B1 of the deep‑well plate.
Continue the same pattern down the column, incrementing tube‑rack slot numbers as you go.

steps.title: Double extraction aliquoting
steps.instruction: Aliquot each patient sample twice, using 200 µL (default) per aliquot, into consecutive wells as described. The process handles up to 47 patient samples per run and skips wells G12 and H12.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL from patient tube slot 4 position A1 into well A1 of the deep‑well plate.
Transfer 200 µL from the same tube (slot 4 position A1) into well B1 of the deep‑well plate.
Transfer 200 µL from patient tube slot 4 position B1 into well C1 of the deep‑well plate.
Transfer 200 µL from the same tube (slot 4 position B1) into well D1 of the deep‑well plate.
Repeat this pattern for each subsequent patient sample, continuing up to 47 samples per run.

steps.title: Start robot run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to execute the loaded protocol on the OT‑2 robot.
